extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, researchers, and policymakers seeking concise country fact profiles
extracted.subtask_description: A concise, standardized country fact-sheet / factbook entry that summarizes a country's background, geography, people, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, and transnational issues for reference or comparative use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: A short narrative overview of the country's historical development, colonization/independence history, political evolution, major social/economic themes, and notable political issues (e.g., regional separatism, emigration).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes concise context such as discovery/colonization, major political changes (e.g., one-party to multi-party), economic or social hardships (drought, emigration), and recent political developments or stability indicators. Example text: 'The uninhabited islands were discovered and colonized by the Portuguese... Following independence in 1975... Cape Verde continues to exhibit one of Africa's most stable democratic governments.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography
rubrics_metrics.description: Physical and locational data: location, geographic coordinates, map references, total area (land and water), area comparative note, land boundaries, coastline length, maritime claims, climate, terrain, elevation extremes, natural resources, land use, irrigated land, natural hazards, environment current issues, environment international agreements, and any geography-specific note.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numeric and descriptive entries for each sub-item where relevant (e.g., 'area: total/land/water', 'coastline: X km', 'territorial sea: 12 nm', 'climate: temperate/subarctic/etc.'). Include short explanatory notes where appropriate (e.g., strategic location, permafrost obstacles).

rubrics_metrics.name: People
rubrics_metrics.description: Demographic indicators including total population (with date), age structure, median age, population growth rate, birth and death rates, net migration rate, sex ratio (by age groups), infant mortality rate, life expectancy at birth, total fertility rate, HIV/AIDS prevalence and counts, nationality adjective/noun, ethnic group composition, religions, languages, and literacy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report numeric estimates with year (e.g., 'Population: 32,507,874 (July 2004 est.)'). Include breakdowns by sex where provided and any census notes (e.g., 'based on the 1991 census'). Where available, present both rates and absolute counts for health indicators (HIV/AIDS people living with HIV/AIDS, deaths).

rubrics_metrics.name: Government
rubrics_metrics.description: Political and administrative: conventional country names, government type, capital, administrative divisions, independence date, national holiday, constitution date/notes, legal system, suffrage, executive branch (chief of state, head of government, cabinet), legislative branch (structure, number of seats, elections), judicial branch, political parties and leaders, political pressure groups, international organization participation, diplomatic representation (in US and from US), and flag description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include officeholders' names and dates where relevant, election dates and results summaries (percent of vote, seats by party) when given, and concise descriptions of legal system distinctions (e.g., common law vs civil law in Quebec). Diplomatic details may list addresses and contact numbers when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview narrative and economic statistics: GDP (PPP), real GDP growth rate, GDP per capita, GDP composition by sector (agriculture/industry/services), investment (gross fixed), population below poverty line, household income distribution/Gini index, inflation rate, labor force size and occupational breakdown, unemployment rate, budget (revenues/expenditures), public debt, agriculture products, major industries, industrial production growth rate, electricity production/consumption/exports/imports, oil and natural gas production/consumption/exports/imports/proved reserves, current account balance, exports/imports (values and commodity/partner breakdowns), reserves of foreign exchange & gold, external debt, economic aid (donor/recipient), currency and exchange rates, and fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide both narrative context and numeric indicators with year tags (e.g., 'GDP - real growth rate: 1.7% (2003 est.)'). For trade and energy items include commodity lists and major trading partners. Note any special economic conditions (e.g., high remittances, trade deficits financed by aid).

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications
rubrics_metrics.description: Communications infrastructure and usage statistics: telephones (main lines, mobile cellular counts), telephone system assessment (domestic/international), radio and television broadcast station counts, numbers of radios/televisions, internet country code, internet hosts, number of ISPs, and internet users.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include both infrastructure descriptions (e.g., satellite earth stations, submarine cables) and usage counts with years. Provide qualitative assessment snippets when present (e.g., 'general assessment: excellent service provided by modern technology').

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation
rubrics_metrics.description: Transport infrastructure: railways (total and gauge), highways (total/paved/unpaved), waterways, pipelines (crude/refined oil, LPG lengths), ports and harbors (major ports), merchant marine (totals, types, foreign ownership), airports (total, with paved/unpaved runway breakdowns by length), and heliports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply numeric lengths and counts with year estimates, and list notable shared waterways or seaways (e.g., Saint Lawrence Seaway). Include notes on operational status where provided (e.g., airports reported nonoperational).

rubrics_metrics.name: Military
rubrics_metrics.description: Military organization and capacity: branches, military manpower statistics (military age and obligation, availability, fit for service, reaching military age annually), military expenditures (total dollars and percent of GDP).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report the names of principal branches and both absolute and rate measures for manpower and spending with year annotations (e.g., 'Military expenditures - percent of GDP: 1.1% (2003)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Cross-border and international concerns: managed or unresolved international disputes (maritime and territorial), refugee and internally displaced person counts (by country of origin), illicit drug production/transit and money-laundering vulnerabilities, and other transnational problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include brief descriptions of dispute status (e.g., 'managed maritime boundary disputes...'), numeric refugee/IDP counts with origin countries and year, and qualitative notes about transnational crime roles (e.g., 'transit point for heroin and cocaine').
